agent.en: The travel agent helped us compare several flight options.
agent.zh: 旅行社人員幫我們比較了幾個航班選項。

aggressive.en: The company used an aggressive marketing strategy to enter the new market.
aggressive.zh: 這家公司採取積極的行銷策略進入新市場。

ago.en: We first visited this museum two years ago.
ago.zh: 我們兩年前第一次參觀這座博物館。

agree.en: Most students agree that regular review helps them remember vocabulary.
agree.zh: 大多數學生都同意規律複習有助於記住單字。

agreement.en: The two schools signed an agreement to share teaching resources.
agreement.zh: 兩所學校簽署協議，共享教學資源。

agriculture.en: Modern agriculture often uses technology to reduce water consumption.
agriculture.zh: 現代農業常利用科技來減少用水量。

ahead.en: Please read the next chapter ahead of tomorrow's class.
ahead.zh: 請在明天上課前先閱讀下一章。

aid.en: The organization sent medical aid to the flooded area.
aid.zh: 該組織將醫療援助送往淹水地區。

aim.en: Our main aim is to make the information easier to understand.
aim.zh: 我們的主要目標是讓資訊更容易理解。

air.en: Fresh air entered the room when we opened the windows.
air.zh: 我們打開窗戶後，新鮮空氣進入房間。

aircraft.en: The aircraft landed safely despite the strong wind.
aircraft.zh: 儘管風很強，飛機仍安全降落。

airline.en: The airline announced a delay because of bad weather.
airline.zh: 航空公司因天候不佳宣布班機延誤。

airport.en: We arrived at the airport two hours before departure.
airport.zh: 我們在起飛前兩小時抵達機場。

alarm.en: The fire alarm rang during our afternoon class.
alarm.zh: 下午上課時火警警報響了。

album.en: She showed us a photo album from her trip to Japan.
album.zh: 她給我們看了她去日本旅行的相簿。

alcohol.en: The science class discussed how alcohol affects the human body.
alcohol.zh: 自然科課堂討論了酒精如何影響人體。

alive.en: The plant was still alive after several days without water.
alive.zh: 這株植物好幾天沒澆水後仍然活著。

all.en: All students must submit the form before Friday afternoon.
all.zh: 所有學生都必須在星期五下午前交表格。

allow.en: The new rule will allow students to borrow more books.
allow.zh: 新規定將允許學生借更多書。

almost.en: We almost missed the bus because the meeting ended late.
almost.zh: 因為會議太晚結束，我們差點錯過公車。

alone.en: She preferred to study alone when preparing for difficult exams.
alone.zh: 準備困難考試時，她比較喜歡自己讀書。

along.en: We walked along the river and took several photos.
along.zh: 我們沿著河邊散步並拍了幾張照片。

aloud.en: The teacher asked each student to read one sentence aloud.
aloud.zh: 老師請每位學生大聲朗讀一句話。

alphabet.en: Children usually learn the alphabet before they begin reading simple words.
alphabet.zh: 孩子通常先學字母表，才開始閱讀簡單單字。

already.en: I had already finished the homework before dinner.
already.zh: 我在晚餐前就已經完成作業。

also.en: The library has computers and also offers free internet access.
also.zh: 圖書館有電腦，也提供免費網路。

alter.en: A small change in temperature can alter the result of the experiment.
alter.zh: 溫度的小幅變化可能改變實驗結果。

alternative.en: Cycling is a healthy alternative to taking short car trips.
alternative.zh: 騎腳踏車是短程開車以外的健康選擇。

although.en: Although the test was difficult, most students finished on time.
although.zh: 雖然考試很難，大多數學生仍準時完成。

altogether.en: There were altogether thirty students in the final round.
altogether.zh: 決賽總共有三十名學生。

always.en: She always checks her answers before handing in a test.
always.zh: 她交考卷前總是會檢查答案。

amaze.en: The clear night sky can amaze visitors from large cities.
amaze.zh: 清澈的夜空常讓來自大城市的遊客感到驚奇。

amazing.en: The team made an amazing recovery after a difficult start.
amazing.zh: 這支隊伍在開局不利後出現驚人的逆轉。

ambition.en: Her ambition is to become a researcher in environmental science.
ambition.zh: 她的志向是成為環境科學研究員。

ambulance.en: An ambulance arrived within minutes after the accident was reported.
ambulance.zh: 事故通報後幾分鐘內救護車就到了。

among.en: The teacher divided the work among four small groups.
among.zh: 老師把工作分給四個小組。

amount.en: The amount of rainfall increased sharply during the summer.
amount.zh: 夏季的降雨量大幅增加。

amuse.en: The funny story managed to amuse everyone in the room.
amuse.zh: 那個有趣的故事逗樂了房間裡的每個人。

amusement.en: The park provides simple amusement for families with young children.
amusement.zh: 這座公園為有幼兒的家庭提供簡單的娛樂活動。

analysis.en: Our analysis showed a clear difference between the two groups.
analysis.zh: 我們的分析顯示兩組之間有明顯差異。

analyze.en: Scientists analyze the samples carefully before reporting their findings.
analyze.zh: 科學家在公布研究結果前會仔細分析樣本。

ancestor.en: The exhibition explains how one ancestor can connect many family branches.
ancestor.zh: 展覽說明一位祖先如何連結許多家族分支。

ancient.en: The museum displays tools used by people in ancient times.
ancient.zh: 博物館展示古代人使用的工具。

and.en: We compared the advantages and disadvantages before making a choice.
and.zh: 我們在做選擇前比較了優點和缺點。

anger.en: He took a short walk to calm his anger.
anger.zh: 他散了一小段步來平息怒氣。

angle.en: The camera was placed at a different angle for the second photo.
angle.zh: 第二張照片把相機放在不同角度。

angry.en: She felt angry because the decision seemed unfair.
angry.zh: 她因為覺得這個決定不公平而生氣。

animal.en: The zoo provides each animal with a suitable living environment.
animal.zh: 動物園為每隻動物提供合適的生活環境。

ankle.en: He injured his ankle while playing basketball after school.
ankle.zh: 他放學後打籃球時傷到了腳踝。

announce.en: The principal will announce the contest results tomorrow morning.
announce.zh: 校長明天早上會公布比賽結果。

announcement.en: The school made an announcement about the new class schedule.
announcement.zh: 學校發布了關於新課表的公告。

annoy.en: Repeated phone notifications can annoy people who are trying to study.
annoy.zh: 不斷出現的手機通知會打擾正在讀書的人。

annual.en: The school holds an annual sports day every spring.
annual.zh: 學校每年春天都會舉辦年度運動會。

another.en: If this method does not work, we can try another one.
another.zh: 如果這個方法沒有效，我們可以試另一個。

answer.en: Please explain how you reached your answer to the question.
answer.zh: 請說明你是如何得到這題答案的。

ant.en: An ant can carry objects much heavier than its own body.
ant.zh: 螞蟻能搬運比自己身體重很多的物體。

anxiety.en: Deep breathing can sometimes reduce anxiety before an important presentation.
anxiety.zh: 重要報告前做深呼吸有時能減輕焦慮。

anxious.en: Many students feel anxious before receiving important test results.
anxious.zh: 許多學生在收到重要考試成績前會感到焦慮。

any.en: Please ask if you have any questions about the assignment.
any.zh: 如果你對作業有任何問題，請提出來。

anybody.en: Anybody can join the club if they are interested in science.
anybody.zh: 任何對科學有興趣的人都可以加入這個社團。

anyhow.en: The weather was poor, but we enjoyed the trip anyhow.
anyhow.zh: 雖然天氣不好，我們還是很享受這趟旅行。

anymore.en: We do not use that old computer anymore.
anymore.zh: 我們已經不再使用那台舊電腦了。

anyone.en: Anyone can improve with enough practice and useful feedback.
anyone.zh: 任何人只要有足夠練習和有用回饋都能進步。

anything.en: Do not change anything until the teacher checks the experiment.
anything.zh: 在老師檢查實驗前不要改動任何東西。

anyway.en: The bus was late, but we arrived on time anyway.
anyway.zh: 公車雖然晚到，我們最後還是準時抵達。

anywhere.en: With online materials, students can study almost anywhere.
anywhere.zh: 有了線上教材，學生幾乎可以在任何地方讀書。

apart.en: The two buildings stand about fifty meters apart.
apart.zh: 兩棟建築物相距約五十公尺。

apartment.en: Her apartment is close enough to walk to school.
apartment.zh: 她的公寓離學校很近，可以走路上學。

apologize.en: He decided to apologize after realizing that his comment was hurtful.
apologize.zh: 他發現自己的話傷人後決定道歉。

apology.en: Her apology helped the two friends resolve their disagreement.
apology.zh: 她的道歉幫助兩位朋友化解了爭執。

apparent.en: It became apparent that the original plan would cost too much.
apparent.zh: 很明顯原本的計畫成本會太高。

apparently.en: Apparently, the meeting was moved to a different classroom.
apparently.zh: 看來會議已經改到另一間教室。

appeal.en: The campaign has strong appeal among young people who care about nature.
appeal.zh: 這項活動對關心自然的年輕人很有吸引力。

appear.en: Several stars appear just after the sun goes down.
appear.zh: 太陽下山後不久，幾顆星星就會出現。

appearance.en: The building's appearance changed after a major renovation.
appearance.zh: 這棟建築在大規模整修後外觀改變了。

apple.en: She packed an apple and a sandwich for lunch.
apple.zh: 她帶了一顆蘋果和一個三明治當午餐。

application.en: The scholarship application must be submitted before the end of March.
application.zh: 獎學金申請必須在三月底前送出。

apply.en: Students can apply for the program through the school website.
apply.zh: 學生可以透過學校網站申請這項計畫。

appoint.en: The club will appoint a new leader at next week's meeting.
appoint.zh: 社團會在下週會議任命新的負責人。

appointment.en: She made an appointment with the counselor after school.
appointment.zh: 她約了放學後和輔導老師會談。

appreciate.en: I appreciate your help with the final part of the project.
appreciate.zh: 我很感謝你協助完成專題的最後部分。

approach.en: The teacher used a practical approach to explain the difficult topic.
approach.zh: 老師用實際的方法解釋這個困難主題。

appropriate.en: Please choose appropriate language when writing a formal email.
appropriate.zh: 撰寫正式電子郵件時請使用適當的語言。

approval.en: The plan cannot begin until it receives official approval.
approval.zh: 這項計畫在獲得正式核准前不能開始。

approve.en: The committee will approve the proposal if it meets all requirements.
approve.zh: 如果提案符合所有要求，委員會就會批准。

approximately.en: Approximately two hundred students attended the school festival.
approximately.zh: 大約有兩百名學生參加校慶活動。

April.en: The competition will take place in April this year.
April.zh: 這項比賽今年四月舉行。

area.en: This area is famous for its hot springs and mountain views.
area.zh: 這個地區以溫泉和山景聞名。

argue.en: Students should argue their points with evidence rather than emotion.
argue.zh: 學生應該用證據而不是情緒來支持自己的論點。

argument.en: A strong argument needs clear reasons and reliable evidence.
argument.zh: 有力的論點需要清楚理由和可靠證據。

arise.en: New problems may arise when too many changes happen at once.
arise.zh: 一次發生太多變化時可能會出現新問題。

arm.en: He raised his arm to ask a question during class.

army.en: The history lesson explained how the army defended the city.
army.zh: 歷史課說明軍隊如何保衛這座城市。

around.en: We sat around the table and discussed the project together.
around.zh: 我們圍著桌子坐下，一起討論專題。

arrange.en: Please arrange the books by topic before putting them away.
arrange.zh: 請先依主題整理書籍，再把它們放回去。

arrangement.en: The seating arrangement made group discussion much easier.
arrangement.zh: 座位安排讓小組討論容易許多。

arrest.en: The police made an arrest after reviewing the security video.
arrest.zh: 警方查看監視錄影後進行逮捕。

arrival.en: We checked the arrival time before leaving for the station.
arrival.zh: 出發去車站前，我們先確認了抵達時間。

arrive.en: Please arrive ten minutes early for the interview.
arrive.zh: 面試請提早十分鐘到達。

art.en: The art class visited a gallery to study modern paintings.
art.zh: 美術課去畫廊研究現代畫作。

article.en: I found an interesting article about renewable energy online.
article.zh: 我在網路上找到一篇關於再生能源的有趣文章。

artist.en: The artist used recycled materials to create the sculpture.
artist.zh: 這位藝術家使用回收材料創作雕塑。

artistic.en: Her artistic skills improved after months of regular practice.
artistic.zh: 經過數月規律練習，她的藝術技巧進步了。

as.en: As the weather improved, more people returned to the park.
as.zh: 隨著天氣好轉，更多人回到公園。

ash.en: A thin layer of ash covered the ground after the eruption.
ash.zh: 火山爆發後，地面覆蓋著一層薄薄的火山灰。

aside.en: He put the book aside and started writing his notes.
aside.zh: 他把書放到一旁，開始寫筆記。

ask.en: Do not be afraid to ask for help when you need it.
ask.zh: 需要幫助時不要害怕開口求助。

asleep.en: The baby was already asleep when we arrived home.
asleep.zh: 我們到家時寶寶已經睡著了。

aspect.en: The report examines every important aspect of the problem.
aspect.zh: 這份報告檢視了這個問題的每個重要面向。

assess.en: Teachers use several methods to assess student progress fairly.
assess.zh: 老師使用多種方法公平評量學生進步情況。

assessment.en: The final assessment includes both a written test and a presentation.
assessment.zh: 期末評量包含筆試和口頭報告。

assign.en: The teacher will assign each group a different research topic.
assign.zh: 老師會分配不同研究主題給每個小組。

assignment.en: The assignment requires students to compare two different viewpoints.
assignment.zh: 這份作業要求學生比較兩種不同觀點。

assist.en: Several volunteers came to assist with the school event.
assist.zh: 幾位志工前來協助學校活動。

assistance.en: Please ask for assistance if you cannot use the equipment safely.
assistance.zh: 如果你無法安全操作設備，請尋求協助。

assistant.en: The laboratory assistant prepared the materials before the experiment began.
assistant.zh: 實驗室助理在實驗開始前準備好材料。

associate.en: Many people associate this song with their high school years.
associate.zh: 許多人會把這首歌和高中時期聯想在一起。

association.en: The student association organized a charity event for the community.
association.zh: 學生會為社區舉辦了一場慈善活動。

assume.en: We should not assume the result before examining the data.
assume.zh: 在檢視資料前，我們不應先假設結果。

assure.en: The teacher tried to assure us that the test would be fair.
assure.zh: 老師試著向我們保證考試會公平。

astonish.en: The final score may astonish people who expected a close game.
astonish.zh: 最後比分可能讓原本預期比賽接近的人感到驚訝。

athlete.en: The athlete trained every morning before going to school.
athlete.zh: 這名運動員每天上學前都會訓練。

athletic.en: The school built a new athletic field beside the gym.
athletic.zh: 學校在體育館旁新建了一座運動場。

atmosphere.en: The café has a quiet atmosphere that is suitable for studying.
atmosphere.zh: 這家咖啡店氣氛安靜，很適合讀書。

attach.en: Please attach the file before sending the email.
attach.zh: 寄出電子郵件前請先附上檔案。

attack.en: The article described a cyber attack on a large company.
attack.zh: 這篇文章描述一起針對大型公司的網路攻擊。

attempt.en: Her first attempt was unsuccessful, but she learned from it.
attempt.zh: 她第一次嘗試沒有成功，但她從中學到了東西。

attend.en: All team members should attend the meeting on Thursday.
attend.zh: 所有隊員都應參加星期四的會議。

attendance.en: Regular attendance is important for keeping up with the course.
attendance.zh: 規律出席對跟上課程進度很重要。

attention.en: Please pay close attention to the safety instructions before starting.
attention.zh: 開始前請仔細注意安全說明。

attitude.en: A positive attitude can help students face difficult tasks with confidence.
attitude.zh: 正向態度能幫助學生更有信心面對困難任務。

attract.en: Bright flowers attract many bees during the spring.
attract.zh: 鮮豔的花朵在春天會吸引許多蜜蜂。

attraction.en: The night market is a popular attraction for visitors to the city.
attraction.zh: 夜市是遊客來這座城市時很受歡迎的景點。

attractive.en: The website uses an attractive design that is easy to navigate.
attractive.zh: 這個網站採用美觀而且容易操作的設計。

audience.en: The audience asked several questions after the presentation ended.
audience.zh: 報告結束後，觀眾提出了幾個問題。

August.en: The summer program will end in the middle of August.
August.zh: 暑期課程會在八月中旬結束。

aunt.en: My aunt taught me how to cook this traditional dish.
aunt.zh: 我的阿姨教我做這道傳統料理。

author.en: The author explains the main idea clearly in the first chapter.
author.zh: 作者在第一章清楚說明了主要觀念。

authority.en: Local authority officials inspected the building after the earthquake.
authority.zh: 地方主管機關人員在地震後檢查了建築物。

automatic.en: The doors are automatic and open when someone approaches.
automatic.zh: 這些門是自動的，有人靠近時就會打開。

automatically.en: The app automatically saves your work every few minutes.
automatically.zh: 這個應用程式每隔幾分鐘會自動儲存你的工作。

autumn.en: The leaves begin to change color in early autumn.

available.en: Extra practice materials are available on the class website.
available.zh: 班級網站上有額外的練習教材可供使用。

average.en: The average score increased after students received more practice.
average.zh: 學生獲得更多練習後，平均分數提高了。

avoid.en: Try to avoid checking your phone while you are studying.
avoid.zh: 讀書時盡量避免查看手機。

awake.en: I was still awake when the storm started after midnight.
awake.zh: 半夜暴風雨開始時我還醒著。

award.en: She received an award for her excellent science project.
award.zh: 她因優秀的科學專題獲得獎項。

aware.en: Students should be aware of the risks of sharing personal information online.
aware.zh: 學生應了解在網路上分享個人資訊的風險。

away.en: The station is only a ten-minute walk away from school.
away.zh: 車站離學校走路只有十分鐘。

awful.en: The weather was awful, so the outdoor event was canceled.
awful.zh: 天氣很糟，因此戶外活動被取消。

baby.en: The baby smiled when she heard her mother's voice.
baby.zh: 寶寶聽到媽媽的聲音時笑了。

back.en: Please put the books back on the shelf after using them.
back.zh: 用完書後請把它們放回書架。

background.en: The article provides useful background information about the historical event.
background.zh: 這篇文章提供了關於這個歷史事件的實用背景資料。

backward.en: He took one backward step to avoid the moving bicycle.
backward.zh: 他往後退了一步，以避開移動中的腳踏車。

bacteria.en: Some bacteria are helpful and play important roles in digestion.
bacteria.zh: 有些細菌是有益的，並在消化中扮演重要角色。

bad.en: A bad habit can be difficult to change without a clear plan.
bad.zh: 沒有明確計畫時，壞習慣可能很難改掉。

badly.en: The road was badly damaged by the heavy rain.

bag.en: She placed her books and laptop in a large bag.
bag.zh: 她把書和筆電放進一個大袋子裡。

balance.en: Students need to balance schoolwork, rest, and personal interests.
balance.zh: 學生需要在課業、休息和個人興趣之間取得平衡。
